title: AI Field Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are part of the AI Core team but your work extends beyond it. Most of your time is spent embedded within one of our portfolio groups: responsible for deploying and operating the AI Hub for the companies within that group and integrating AI into their real business processes. Beyond this, you support the M&A team to develop AI driven use cases to support our acquisition strategy. You build production-grade systems, connect AI capabilities to existing infrastructure and make sure what gets deployed actually runs stably in the long term. You step in when complex AI use cases require real engineering work and changes to the companies cloud infrastructure.

What You Will Work On

  • Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions integrated into real operational systems: ERP, accounting tools, email inboxes, and legacy workflows
  • Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise services including MCP servers, Microsoft Graph, Git/Bitbucket, and REST APIs
  • You understand that shipping a solution is just the beginning. Your designs gather signals and feedback from operations for a continuous improvement cycle. Ensure AI systems run with full observability: logging, alerting, and audit trails that let non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening.
  • Work closely with AI Champions and portfolio group teams to translate business needs into implementable AI solutions and enable the Champions with your technical expertise to implement more use cases without your help in the future
  • Deploy, configure, and operate AI Hub instances (Open WebUI) for the portfolio companies within your assigned portfolio group: including onboarding, custom model setup, tool integrations, SSO, and ongoing maintenance
  • Support the M&A team to identify new targets, automate outreach and, support Due Diligence of new acquisition targets

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in a DevOps, backend engineering, or platform engineering role
  • Python fluency: you write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable owning a codebase
  • Practical experience with cloud infrastructure & production deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD deployment workflows: including deploying and configuring containerised applications for end-customer environments
  • AI-native: you work with LLMs, know their limits, and have shipped something real using them
  • Strong communication skills: you translate technical decisions into business language and can work effectively with non-technical stakeholders
  • German (native or C2) and English (fluent): both are used daily across teams and OpCos

Bonus

  • Experience integrating AI into ERP, CRM, or accounting systems
  • Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tool-calling patterns
  • Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation)
  • Experience with enterprise authentication and identity (OAuth, SSO, Azure AD / Entra ID)
  • Prior experience working across multiple companies or in a group / holding structure

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A dual role with real variety: strategic platform work at group level combined with hands-on implementation inside a Portfolio Platform
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with regular on-site time
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: WerkstudentIn AI Agent Developer
description:
Du hast Erfahrung mit KI und willst sie an echten Kundenprojekten einsetzen? Bei uns baust du AI Agents, die in Produktion gehen. Keine Proof-of-Concepts für die Schublade.

Wir sind ein KI-Startup aus Berlin, spezialisiert auf Automatisierung im Kundenservice. Wir bauen AI Agents, Voicebots und Automatisierungslösungen für Unternehmen im deutschen Mittelstand. Gegründet 2023 von Oscar Schwarz und Ludwig Sickert, aktuell ein Team von rund 10 Leuten. Mit AIdapt haben wir ein eigenes SaaS-Produkt, das AI Agents analysiert und messbar verbessert.

Aufgaben

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du nur auf Konzeptebene arbeiten willst. Bei uns bedeutet AI Agent Development: Code schreiben, APIs debuggen, Conversation-Flows implementieren, Systeme integrieren – hands-on, mit direktem Impact bei echten Kundenprojekten.

Du arbeitest an der Entwicklung echter AI-Agenten, die in Produktion gehen. Das bedeutet:

  • Entwicklung von AI Agents: Aufbau und Implementierung von Chat- und Voice-Agents auf Plattformen wie Parloa, Cognigy, telli oder vergleichbaren Conversational AI Systemen
  • Backend-Integration: Anbindung und Konfiguration externer Systeme über APIs (REST, SOAP, Webhooks)
  • Testing & Optimierung: Durchführung von Tests, Debugging und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Agent-Performance
  • Technische Dokumentation: Erstellung von technischer Dokumentation für Implementierungen und Integrationen
  • Kundenprojekte: Direkte Mitarbeit an realen Kundenprojekten

Bei uns erhältst du klare Aufgaben, Feedback und kannst Verantwortung Schritt für Schritt ausbauen

Qualifikation

  • Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Computerlinguistik oder einem verwandten technischen Studiengang
  • Grundlegende Programmierkenntnisse (idealerweise Python, JavaScript/TypeScript) und Verständnis von APIs und Backend-Systemen
  • Du bist bereit, dich in technische Herausforderungen reinzufuchsen und Lösungen zu finden
  • Begeisterung für AI Agents, Large Language Models und moderne Conversational AI Technologien
  • Hands-on Mentalität: Du willst nicht nur planen, sondern selbst umsetzen
  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Verfügbarkeit von 15-20 Stunden pro Woche

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung mit Conversational AI Plattformen (Parloa, Cognigy, Voiceflow, etc.)
  • Erfahrung mit Workflow-Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n oder Make
  • Verständnis von Customer Service Prozessen
  • Erste Erfahrung mit LLMs und Prompt Engineering

Benefits

  • Echte technische Verantwortung: Du baust Lösungen, die wirklich produktiv gehen – keine Proof-of-Concepts, sondern AI Agents mit messbarem Impact
  • Cutting-Edge Technologie: Arbeit mit den neuesten Conversational AI Plattformen und Large Language Models‍
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Remote-Option und flexible Zeiteinteilung, die sich mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lässt‍
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Regelmäßiges Feedback und Coaching, um dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzubringen
  • Start-up Culture: Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen, deine Ideen zählen
  • ‍Übernahmeperspektive: Bei guter Performance besteht die Möglichkeit einer Übernahme nach dem Studium‍

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess ab

Wir halten den Prozess bewusst schlank und transparent:

  • 15 Minuten Telefonat mit HR – Kurzer Abgleich zu Motivation, Verfügbarkeit und Rahmenbedingungen.
  • 30 Minuten fachlicher Austausch mit deinem Manager – Einblick in Aufgaben, Arbeitsweise und technische Anforderungen.
  • Vor-Ort-Termin mit Oscar und Ludwig – Kennenlernen, Blick ins Team und gemeinsamer Abgleich der Erwartungen.

Sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und ein kurzes, fachlich begründetes Statement, warum dich diese Rolle interessiert und was du einbringen möchtest.

Wir melden uns innerhalb von drei Werktagen bei dir.

title: Account Manager (m/w/d) - Eschborn
description:
Über TimeLapse Go

TimeLapse Go entwickelt intelligente Lösungen für die digitale Baustellendokumentation. Im Zuge unseres Wachstums auf dem deutschen Markt suchen wir einen Account Manager (m/w/d), der unsere Kunden nach Vertragsabschluss betreut, die erfolgreiche Umsetzung ihrer Projekte begleitet und zu einer langfristigen Kundenbindung beiträgt.

Die Position

Dabei sind Sie für die Qualität der Kundenbeziehung verantwortlich und tragen aktiv zur Kundenzufriedenheit, Kundenbindung sowie zur Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen bei.

Aufgaben

  • Nach Vertragsabschluss sind Sie der Hauptansprechpartner für unsere Kunden.

  • Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Business Developer, Technischem Vertriebsmitarbeiter und weiteren Beteiligten und stellen so einen reibungslosen Projektablauf sicher.
  • Sie sind Ansprechpartner für unser Netzwerk externer Techniker und koordinieren deren Einsätze.
  • Sie planen und koordinieren Installationen, technische Einsätze sowie den weiteren Projektverlauf.

  • Sie erkennen Anforderungen frühzeitig, behalten die einzelnen Projektphasen im Blick und wirken aktiv an der Lösung operativer Themen mit.
  • Sie identifizieren zusätzliche Geschäftsmöglichkeiten bei bestehenden Kunden.
  • Sie dokumentieren und verfolgen die Projekte im CRM und wirken an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Prozesse mit.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil

  • Kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung bzw. Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Projektmanagement, Kundenbetreuung oder Vertrieb.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Account Management, in der Kundenbetreuung, im Projektmanagement oder in der operativen B2B-Koordination.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

  • Gute Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
  • Sehr gute Organisationsfähigkeit und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten.
  • Die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit Blick fürs Detail zu koordinieren.
  • Teamgeist und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnern.

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
description:
**Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?**🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen.

Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens.

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.

  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.
  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.

  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.

  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.
  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.

  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.
  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

  • Genuine interest in cloud and information security, governance, and compliance, and the drive to own outcomes, not just tasks.

  • Comfort reading cloud configurations and IaC across multiple providers. Ability to automate scales with level.

  • Careful, structured, and trustworthy. You will handle sensitive material.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Terraform, and experience with AWS, GCP, and/or Azure.

  • Exposure to a compliance automation platform.

  • Prior general software engineering experience, ideally in the stacks we use day to day (Go, SQL, and cloud infrastructure)

How we work

We are 100% remote across Europe and hire anywhere within roughly two hours of Central European Time (CEST). We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days. We work async by default, write things down, and protect people's focus time.

What we offer

  • Real ownership of the security and compliance program from the ground up.

  • Meaningful equity. You are an early employee, and your stake reflects it.

  • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market.

  • A quarterly European offsite, and a team that takes both the mission and each other’s time seriously.

The honest version

This is early, we are literally at the start today. You would start from a blank page, not maintain someone else's polished program. That is the appeal if you want to build a security and compliance function from scratch and carry it all the way to real certifications. It is daunting if you are looking for a mature program to step into. We hire at multiple levels, so this can be a first serious role or a senior mandate. Either way, you will own real outcomes fast.

title: Software Engineer Enablement and Product
description:
kausable is moving from a pure research lab toward products used by real customers. As our software engineer for enablement and product, you own two scopes.

Enablement: internal platforms and tools, developer workflows; in a sense products where the customers are your research-science colleagues.

Product: externally shipped functionality. This is the software layer around our AI: the applications through which users interact with our AI and the delivery infrastructure that unlocks them.

The boundary with our ML Product Engineer is deliberate. That role owns model serving, evaluation and inference. You own the adaptable software systems through which researchers build and users experience those capabilities.

Tasks

  • Build customer-facing applications and integrations from scoping through delivery.
  • Build internal platforms and tools that reduce setup time and cognitive load for researchers.
  • Improve researcher experience through reproducible environments, CI/CD, automation and clear repository standards.
  • Design APIs, workflows and frontend interfaces that keep complex model capabilities usable.
  • Contain technical debt through thoughtful abstractions, testing and documentation.
  • Act as a technical bridge between researchers, product stakeholders and the people using what we build.

Requirements

  • Broad software engineering experience across backend, infrastructure and at least one modern frontend stack.
  • Deep understanding of software design and complexity management: you build systems that remain easy to change.
  • Strong Python skills plus TypeScript, JavaScript or another modern frontend language.
  • Experience with containers, cloud infrastructure and production delivery.
  • A track record of customer-facing or cross-functional project work.
  • Clear communication, strong problem solving and a pragmatic, self-directed operating style.
  • We are primarily hiring at senior level. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate comparable depth, judgment and ownership.

Nice to have:

  • Internal developer platforms, research tooling or ML infrastructure.
  • Experiment tracking, data tooling or reproducible compute environments.
  • C++ or Rust for performance-sensitive services and tooling.
  • Enough exposure to ML systems to collaborate productively with researchers without being expected to build models.
  • Prior startup, consulting or solutions-engineering experience.

Benefits

🚀 Where This Can Go

You will shape how kausable builds and ships software as we scale: the architecture, tooling, standards and developer experience. The role can grow into ownership of our platform and internal engineering, or into leadership of customer-facing product delivery. The hard part is balancing both horizons: helping the team move today while keeping the system adaptable tomorrow.

🫂 Our Culture

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group

CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.

AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.

Tasks

The Role

You are a core member of the AI Core team, owning the infrastructure that powers AI adoption across 55+ portfolio companies. Your focus is the AI Hub platform (Open WebUI): you keep it running, deploy new instances, build and validate integrations at HQ level, and make sure every company in the group gets a stable, well-configured environment.

We build the AI Hub as a product and support to ship it in every company. Each company owns their HUB and administers it (L1 Support). You are part of the central team that drives features and changes that are of high value for all hubs in the portfolio.

In addition, you are part of the team that serves as the center of expertise (L2 Support) and give guidance and hands-on support when the first level teams need you.

What You Will Work On

  • Platform engineering: new integrations, container images, infrastructure-as-code, deployment tooling and security patches. This is the product that every company runs
  • Release qualification: when the upstream project ships a new version, you assess it (one-way database migrations, breaking changes, patch compatibility), validate it on a canary, and publish a qualified release with notes that an L1 can act on
  • Shared infrastructure: Application Gateway, WAF policies, TLS certificates, Redis, DNS and network peering. This layer is shared across every company and cannot be devolved. A mistake here affects all of them
  • Enable the L1 network and be their technical point of contact: write the developer guides, run onboarding and office hours, and build preflight checks and guardrails that make it safe for a platform admin to deploy and operate their own Hub.
  • Integrations Catalog stewardship: versioned artefacts (tools, skills, agents, integrations) each shipped with a user guide for AI Champions and a developer guide for platform admins
  • Fleet observability: reporting and alerting version parity, uptime, cloud spend and deployment status across all companies.
  • Own the eval service: the service itself, the quality of judges and generators, and the methodology platforms use to measure whether their agents do the work
  • Close the loop. Shipping is the beginning. Your designs gather operational signals from the fleet and feed a continuous improvement cycle

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or cloud operations, including ownership of production systems that others depend on
  • Production cloud experience on Azure or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code in production: Bicep, Terraform, CDK or CloudFormation. We care that you think in IaC.
  • Strong Python skills beyond scripting: you have built and maintained small production services, worked with APIs, and found your way around unfamiliar codebases
  • Comfortable with Linux, Docker, Git and CI/CD as everyday working tools
  • Working knowledge of databases and identity: PostgreSQL in production, and OAuth / SSO / Entra ID concepts
  • AI-native: you use LLMs as tools, understand their operational properties, and have shipped something with them
  • English (fluent): primary working language across the team; German conversational is a plus

Bonus

  • Clear technical writing: Enabling others is a real part of this role and good documentation is part of the work rather than an afterthought
  • Experience building internal platforms or tooling used by other engineering teams
  • Working in multi-tenant or multi-customer cloud environments
  • Contributions to open-source projects, or maintaining a modified version of one in production
  • Practical experience with LLM frameworks, agents, MCP or RAG systems in production
  • French language skills: a share of our portfolio is in France and growing

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A role that shapes the AI backbone for more than 50 software companies across Europe.
  • Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
  • A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
  • Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies.
  • Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
  • Permanent full-time position, remote-first with the option to join the team in the Cologne office
  • A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply

Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

  • Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
  • Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python/Django + Vue.js)
description:
Important: You must be based in Berlin for this role. We offer flexibility to work from home, but this is not a remote-from-anywhere position.

Hivebuy is a Berlin-based B2B procurement SaaS transforming how companies manage purchasing, approvals, orders, invoices, budgets and suppliers.

We’re building much more than a CRUD application. Our platform combines complex procurement workflows, multi-tenant architecture, ERP and accounting integrations, real-time functionality and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to help us build and evolve this platform.

We’re looking for a T-shaped engineer: someone with deep backend expertise who is also comfortable following a feature across the entire stack. You don’t need to be equally strong in Django and Vue, but you should be willing and able to understand, change and ship both.

Our core stack includes Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Elasticsearch, Vue 3, TypeScript and AWS. We run our services on ECS Fargate, manage infrastructure with Terraform, and use Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry and CloudWatch to understand what’s happening in production.

AI coding agents are a normal part of how we develop software. We believe they make strong engineers significantly more effective, but they also make judgment, verification and ownership more important, not less.

Tasks

  • Own features end-to-end. Understand the problem, challenge requirements when necessary, design the solution, implement it, test it, deploy it and verify that it actually works in production.
  • Design and build backend services and APIs using Python, Django and Django REST Framework.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Elasticsearch to build reliable, scalable application and background-processing workflows.
  • Work across the stack when necessary, implementing and debugging functionality in our Vue 3 + TypeScriptfrontend.
  • Build and maintain integrations with external systems such as ERP/accounting platforms, authentication providers, billing systems, Slack and Microsoft Teams.
  • Work on our growing AI-powered product features and help us integrate LLMs responsibly into production workflows.
  • Investigate production issues across the complete system, from browser to API, background workers, databases and infrastructure.
  • Write meaningful automated tests using tools such as pytest, Vitest and Playwright.
  • Improve performance, reliability, monitoring and deployment safety.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and make technical decisions that keep the system maintainable as we grow.
  • Review code and help maintain a high engineering standard across the team.
  • Identify technical improvements proactively. If you see a bad pattern, flaky test, slow endpoint, missing metric or repetitive manual process, we expect you to improve it or make it visible.
  • Use AI coding agents as part of your engineering workflow for implementation, investigation, testing, review and understanding unfamiliar parts of the system.
  • Communicate proactively in our distributed working environment, document important decisions and surface blockers and risks early.

For us, “done” does not mean “PR merged.” Done means the change is running in production, works as intended and has been verified.

Requirements

  • Strong professional experience building and operating production systems with Python and Django, ideally Django REST Framework.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL, including data modelling, migrations, query performance, indexing and diagnosing database-related production issues.
  • Experience designing and evolving asynchronous and distributed workloads, ideally with Celery and Redis, including retries, idempotency, failure handling and long-running tasks.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and system design. You can make pragmatic architectural decisions, explain the trade-offs and evolve existing systems without unnecessary rewrites.
  • Experience owning features and systems from design through production, including deployment, monitoring, verification and incident investigation.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD workflows and deployment strategies, ideally including chunk-based or independently deployable components, safe rollouts, automated quality gates and rollback strategies.
  • Strong experience with production observability. You know how to use metrics, logs, error tracking and profiling to understand system behaviour and find root causes instead of guessing.
  • Experience identifying and solving performance and scalability problems across applications, databases, background workers and infrastructure.
  • Experience working with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure and a good understanding of how applications actually run in production.
  • Enough Vue/TypeScript or comparable frontend experience to own a feature across the full stack, investigate frontend problems and ship frontend changes without depending on another engineer for every UI task.
  • Experience designing and maintaining external integrations, including failure handling, authentication, webhooks and third-party API behaviour.
  • Strong engineering judgment. You can distinguish between something that needs architectural work, something that needs a small pragmatic fix and something that should not be built at all.
  • You proactively identify technical problems and improvements instead of waiting for them to become tickets.
  • You are comfortable challenging requirements, existing architecture and technical decisions when you have a better approach, and can communicate the reasoning clearly.
  • You use AI coding agents as engineering tools, not just code generators, and remain fully responsible for understanding, reviewing, testing and operating what you ship.
  • You are currently based in Berlin or are willing to relocate to Berlin.

Benefits

  • Flexible hybrid work with the freedom to work from home while being part of our Berlin-based team.
  • An office in the heart of Berlin with drinks, snacks and communal lunches.
  • Trust-based working hours. We care about outcomes rather than tracking hours.
  • A high degree of technical ownership and autonomy.
  • Direct influence on architecture, engineering practices and how our technology evolves.
  • AI-native engineering workflows. Modern coding agents are tools we actively expect and encourage you to use.
  • A modern production stack across backend, frontend, infrastructure and observability.
  • Flat hierarchies and short communication paths.
  • The opportunity to shape engineering practices while our team and product grow.
  • Urban Sports Club membership options.
  • BVG Ticket
  • JOB Bicycle

We’re not looking for someone whose primary value is simply writing code quickly.

AI has changed that part of software development.

What matters to us is whether you can understand a problem, make good technical decisions, challenge assumptions, use the tools available to you, verify the result and take responsibility for what happens in production.

You don’t need to know every part of our stack. You do need to be curious enough to investigate what you don’t know and comfortable taking ownership beyond the boundaries of a ticket.

We also know our existing codebase isn’t perfect. We don’t expect you to blindly copy existing patterns just because they’re already there. When you find something that can be better, we want you to say so and help us improve it.

If that’s how you like to work, we’d like to hear from you.

description:
Empower every employee.

Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen.

Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

 

Stellenausschreibung

KI-Orchestrierung steht im Zentrum der Zukunft von Flip. Flip Fusion, ein Multi-Agenten-System zur Code-Generierung, bildet das Herzstück unseres neuesten Produkts. Auch das Ask AI Agent Gateway und die Automatisierung durch Flip Flows laufen auf Fähigkeiten, die unsere KI-Engineers entwickeln und pflegen.

Als Lead AI Engineer übernimmst du die KI-Disziplin: Du verantwortest das Wie, also Architektur, Standards und technische Ausrichtung, über alle drei Bereiche hinweg, führst und entwickelst ein Team von drei AI-Engineers weiter und bleibst dabei hands-on an den anspruchsvollsten Problemen.

Was dich erwartet

  • KI-Architektur verantworten: Definiere eine kohärente KI-Architektur und einheitliche Standards für Flip Fusion, das Ask AI Agent Gateway und Flip Flows, und stimme sie aufeinander ab.

  • Die größte Herausforderung annehmen: Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die für konkrete Anwendungsfälle gebaut sind, aber generisch genug bleiben, um unterschiedliche Kund:innen zu bedienen, immer im Spannungsfeld zwischen hohen Ansprüchen, Machbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz.

  • Die Disziplin führen und weiterentwickeln: Übernimm die disziplinarische Führung für drei KI-Engineers und hilf ihnen dabei, sich zu Engineers zu entwickeln, die den technischen Maßstab selbst setzen.

  • Hands-on bleiben: Rund 70 Prozent deiner Zeit verbringst du im Code, an den Problemen, bei denen dein Urteilsvermögen am meisten zählt. Der Rest entfällt auf technische und disziplinarische Führung.

  • Produktübergreifend Einfluss nehmen: Setze Architekturentscheidungen mit den Product Managern und Engineering Leads um, die die Roadmaps verantworten, die nicht in deinem Bereich liegen, und überzeuge dabei durch das bessere Argument statt durch Weisung.

  • Mit unserem Stack arbeiten: Python, pydantic-ai für Orchestrierung, Qdrant für Vektorsuche, Azure AI für Modelle, deployed auf Kubernetes in ein überwiegend JVM-basiertes (Kotlin, Micronaut) und Go-Backend.

  • Eine junge Disziplin mitgestalten: KI-Engineering ist bei Flip so neu, dass es enormen Gestaltungsspielraum gibt und noch kein festes Playbook existiert.

Was du mitbringst

Wir suchen einen Engineer mit einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament und echter Praxiserfahrung mit agentenbasierten Systemen in Produktion, der eine Disziplin führen möchte, statt nur an einer Codebase zu arbeiten. Wenn dich die Rolle reizt, du aber nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Must-haves:

  • 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz auf Senior- oder Staff-Level, aufbauend auf einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament (Backend, Platform oder Full-Stack).

  • Praxiserfahrung im Design, Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver LLM-basierter Systeme: RAG, Tool Calling und MCP, Orchestrierung und Evals. Keine Prototypen, sondern Systeme, mit denen du auch nach dem Go-live gelebt hast.

  • Erfahrung mit Multi-Agenten-Orchestrierung, die besonders stark gewichtet wird. Das ist der Kern dessen, was du architektonisch verantworten würdest.

  • Nachgewiesene technische Führungserfahrung: Architekturverantwortung, Tech-Lead-Verantwortung, RFCs, Design Reviews oder das Setzen von Standards für ein Team.

  • Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, technische Arbeit voranzubringen, die nicht in deinem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich liegt: Du gewinnst Architekturdiskussionen durch Überzeugungskraft und Glaubwürdigkeit und bist es gewohnt, recht zu haben, ohne die Entscheidungsgewalt zu haben.

  • Nachweise dafür, dass du Menschen weiterentwickelst: Coaching oder Mentoring von Engineers hin zu stärkeren Engineers, statt ihnen die Arbeit abzunehmen.

  • Ein klares, ausdrückliches Bekenntnis zu disziplinarischer Führung. Diese Rolle umfasst die Führung von drei Engineers, und das ist nicht der Teil, den du nur in Kauf nimmst, um den technischen Scope zu bekommen.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (C1).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Formale Erfahrung in der Personalführung: disziplinarische Führung, Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche, Recruiting. Starke Mentoring-Erfahrung zählt genauso viel.

  • Erfahrung in der teamübergreifenden Führung einer Disziplin oder eines Fachbereichs in einer Matrixorganisation.

  • Produkterfahrung im großen Maßstab: Frontline / Deskless Worker, High-Volume-B2B-SaaS oder Vergleichbares.

  • Erfahrung im Kosten-, Latenz- und Zuverlässigkeits-Engineering für LLM-Systeme: Guardrails, Fallbacks, Evaluation Harnesses.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf beliebigem Niveau. In Teilen des Unternehmens hilfreich, für diese Rolle aber nie Voraussetzung.

 

Was wir dir bieten

  • Work-Mode: Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses.

  • Work-Life-Balance: Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an.

  • Erfolge feiern: Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre.

  • Mittendrin statt nur dabei: Du gestaltest Flip aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen.

  • Arbeiten im Ausland: Bei Flip kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen.

Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wird im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. Bei Flip sind alle willkommen ganz egal, welches Geschlecht du hast oder wie alt du bist. Sexuelle Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung und Behinderungen spielen keine Rolle. Das Wichtigste ist, dass DU zu uns passt!

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Empower every employee.

Flip is the leading AI-powered employee experience platform for frontline workers. We're transforming how people do their jobs across the industries that keep the world running: retail, manufacturing, and logistics. One app. One touch. Everything they need.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.

Job Description

AI orchestration is at the centre of where Flip is going. Fusion, a multi-agent code-generation system sits at the core of our newest product, and our Ask AI agent gateway and Flip Flows automation both run on capabilities our AI engineers build and maintain.

As Lead AI Engineer you take over the AI discipline: you own the how (architecture, standards, technical direction) across all three surfaces, you lead and grow a team of three AI engineers, and you stay hands-on where the problems are hardest.

What you can expect

  • Own the AI architecture: Define and align a coherent AI architecture and set of standards across Flip Fusion, Ask AI agent gateway, and Flip Flows.

  • Tackle the hardest challenge: Multi-agent systems, built to specific purposes, generalizable enough for diverse customers, balancing high expectations with feasibility, reliability and cost effectiveness.

  • Lead and grow the discipline: Take over people leadership for three AI engineers and help them level up into engineers who set the technical bar themselves.

  • Stay hands-on: Roughly 70 percent of your time stays in the code, on the problems where your judgment matters most. The rest is technical and people leadership.

  • Influence across products: Land architecture decisions with the product managers and engineering leads who own the roadmaps you don't, by making the better argument rather than by mandate.

  • Work with our stack: Python, pydantic-ai for orchestration, qdrant for vector search, Azure AI for models, deployed on Kubernetes into a mostly JVM-based (Kotlin, Micronaut) and Go backend.

  • Shape a young discipline: AI engineering at Flip is new enough that there is enormous design space and no inherited playbook.

What you bring to the table

We're looking for an engineer with a software engineering foundation and real production depth in agentic systems, who wants to lead a discipline rather than just work a codebase. If you're excited about the role but don't tick every box, we still want to hear from you.

Must-haves:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a senior or staff-level track record, built on a software engineering foundation (backend, platform, or full-stack)

  • Hands-on experience designing, shipping, and operating LLM-powered systems in production: RAG, tool calling and MCP, orchestration, and evals. Not prototypes, systems you lived with after go-live.

  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration, weighted heavily. This is the core of what you would be architecting.

  • Demonstrated technical leadership: architecture ownership, tech lead responsibility, RFCs, design reviews, or setting standards for a team.

  • Proven ability to move technical work you don't own: you win architecture arguments through persuasion and credibility, and you're comfortable being right without being in charge.

  • Evidence that you grow people: coaching or mentoring engineers into stronger engineers rather than absorbing the work yourself.

  • A clear, explicit commitment to people leadership. This role includes managing three engineers and that is not the part you tolerate to get the technical scope.

  • Strong communication skills and business-fluent English (C1).

Nice-to-haves:

  • Formal people-management experience: line management, performance and development conversations, hiring. Strong mentoring evidence counts just as much.

  • Experience leading a discipline or craft across teams in a matrix organisation.

  • Product context at scale: frontline or deskless workforces, high-volume B2B SaaS, or comparable.

  • Cost, latency and reliability engineering for LLM systems: guardrails, fallbacks, evaluation harnesses.

  • German at any level. Useful in parts of the company, never required for this role.

What we offer you

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices - always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Work-Life-Balance: We don't want you to grow roots to your desk chair. That's why we cover the costs of your E-Gym-Wellpass membership and offer job bike leasing.

  • Celebrating success: Expect highly motivated and committed people in a relaxed working atmosphere.

  • Be part of something bigger: You actively shape Flip in your role. Along the way, you are an enabler of the rapid growth process of a young tech company and grow towards your goals, fun is guaranteed.

  • Happy to be a Flipster: Stay tuned for regular team events and culture days that bring us together as Flipsters.

  • Working abroad: At Flip you can also work abroad in the European Union. Let's talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip, everyone is welcome - no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

description:
Talos: Institutional Fabric for Digital Asset Markets

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Technical Solutions Engineer

Talos is seeking a Technical Solutions Engineer to lead technical implementations and connectivity integrations for institutional clients and trading counterparties.

This role sits at the intersection of client services and technical integration. You will manage end-to-end onboarding of exchanges, liquidity providers, and institutional clients onto the Talos platform, ensuring seamless connectivity and successful deployment of our trading infrastructure. This is not a production support role. It is an implementation-focused position requiring structured project execution, technical fluency, and proactive client leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for clients and trading counterparties, from kickoff through successful production deployment.

  • Lead technical integrations involving APIs, FIX connectivity, and platform configuration.

  • Partner with Sales, Account Management, Engineering, and external stakeholders to deliver implementations on schedule.

  • Manage onboarding timelines, track milestones, and communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Configure and validate client environments across Talos’ modular trading and portfolio systems.

  • Troubleshoot integration issues and coordinate resolution with internal engineering teams.

  • Develop and maintain onboarding documentation and integration best practices.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in client onboarding or implementation within capital markets or financial technology.

  • Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to lead stakeholders through structured implementation processes.

  • Experience working with institutional trading systems, market connectivity, or financial infrastructure.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and command line environments.

  • Familiarity with configuration management, source control, and basic scripting (Python preferred).

  • Exposure to FIX protocol, REST APIs, and JSON-based integrations.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations.

Preferred

  • Experience onboarding clients to trading, OMS, EMS, or portfolio systems.

  • Understanding of capital markets workflows and electronic trading infrastructure.

  • Experience coordinating integrations across exchanges, liquidity providers, or institutional counterparties.

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

title: BI Data Analyst
description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the role

We are looking for a BI Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. You will take ownership of analytical projects end-to-end — from scoping business problems through to insight delivery — working closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, Product, Commercial and Operations. You will build and maintain critical dashboards and reporting, surface trends and anomalies in business performance, and use data storytelling to drive measurable business outcomes. You will be expected to leverage AI tools strategically throughout your workflow — from LLM-assisted query generation and analysis summarisation to code review — accelerating delivery while maintaining rigorous standards. You will also provide critical support as the human-in-the-loop to ensure accuracy and repeatability of data analysis in other functions, empowering all our teams to make full use of AI-driven data self-serve

What will you do

  • Take business problems and independently structure them into well-defined analytical tasks

  • Own KPI monitoring and reporting for embedded stakeholder teams, ensuring data accuracy to build quality and confidence in your outputs

  • Root cause and explain in detail data discrepancies, finding solutions to stakeholder problems

  • Build Looker dashboards and Hex notebooks to support deep-dive analysis and stakeholder self-serve

  • Write production-quality SQL and Python, following team coding standards and passing peer review. Additionally assist others to review AI generated outputs.

  • Communicate insights and recommendations clearly — constructing narratives that drive action

  • Use AI tools to improve workflow (e.g. query generation, analysis drafts, documentation) while maintaining quality and accuracy

  • Work with Analytics Engineers to ingest new data sources into the stack as needed

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore)

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

Applications close Monday 24th August.

title: Founders Associate
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

This is a wide-ranging role that’ll require you to move at speed across diverse topics; in return, you’ll gain high levels of ownership and exposure. Example topics include:

  • entering new markets, from research & analysis to planning & delivery

  • helping our new and existing clients get the most out of our software

  • exploring and delivering on opportunities for growth in new verticals and customer segments

This is a high-velocity, high-impact role. To succeed, you’ll need to learn quickly, act with purpose, and absorb & process highly technical information. You’ll need to be strong with data, and have a ‘run through walls’ attitude to overcome the inevitable barriers.

What's in it for you

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation: £75K – £200K

About Kota

Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products → Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution. We're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. We work in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of two days per week in our London or Dublin office.


About the Role

Kota Embed puts our benefits products directly inside the platforms companies already use to run payroll and manage their people. It's one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business: a large, fast-growing base of companies that can offer their teams health and protection benefits through Kota in just a few clicks.

Most of this job is finding where the funnel leaks and fixing the flow - placement, onboarding moments, in-product experience, and the copy that converts inside someone else's product. If your background is mainly paid, SEO, events, and MQL targets, this probably isn't the role for you. Equally, if you've never personally shipped a change to a product surface and measured what it did, this isn't the role either.

This role is responsible for turning that opportunity into live policies at scale. You'll build the growth engine behind Kota Embed - how we position and package Kota inside our partners' products, activate their customer base, and convert them. It's a high-ownership role for someone who loves building the machine, not just running it: you'll shape the strategy and own it end-to-end.



What You'll Do

  • Own the number → converting our Payroll partners' customer base into live Kota policies, end to end. The core motion is self-serve; our sales team backs you up on higher-touch deals.

  • Find where the funnel leaks and fix it → instrument every step from first impression to live policy, form hypotheses about why people drop, ship changes to the flows Kota controls, and build the business case for changes to the flows our partners control.

  • Make sure customers discover Kota at the right moments → whether Kota builds that experience or a partner builds it on our API, you own where and how Kota shows up.

  • Position and package Kota so it converts inside our partners' products → the messaging and in-product copy that turn a benefits section into sign-ups.

  • Design and productise the partner launch playbook → the enablement partners run under their own brand and the lifecycle motions that pull people back, so every new partner and cohort ramps predictably.


Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years doing growth work — in a growth, product growth, or marketing team; we care what you owned, not what it was called. Ideally the first or an early growth hire who built the motion themselves. You are a hands-on, super individual contributor.

  • You came up inside a growth team at a PLG or B2B2C company and have personally shipped onboarding and activation experiments — not briefed them, shipped them. You can pull your own funnel data without asking anyone, and you can mock up a flow in Figma fast enough to put it in front of a partner's product team this week.

  • You've owned a number measured after sign-up → activation, conversion to paid, feature adoption. If your track record is MQLs and launch calendars, this isn't the role.

  • Systems thinking is your sharpest tool → when conversion is flat, your first instinct is to instrument the funnel and find the leak, not rewrite the headline. You form hypotheses, ship changes, read the data, and iterate.

  • Strong product marketing is your second → positioning, packaging and copy that convert inside someone else's product, with no brand or push traffic to lean on.

  • You ship through influence, not authority → most of the surfaces that matter here belong to our partners. Bonus if you've grown a product through a channel or surface you didn't control.

title: Member of Technical Staff, North Modelling (Evals)
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

North is Cohere’s AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data. North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments.

As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about?

This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling. You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users. You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what “good” means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates.

This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role. It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality. You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next.

As a Member of Technical Staff, North Modelling (Evals), You Will:

  • Own the eval strategy for North: define what we need to measure across agent workflows, tool use, enterprise knowledge work such as deep research, document creation or editing, and other human-AI interactions.

  • Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals.

  • Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark.

  • Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams.

You May Be a Good Fit If:

  • You have improved LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-product systems through evals, feedback loops, data curation, prompting, model adaptation, or model selection.

  • You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence.

  • You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs.

  • You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on.

  • You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding.

  • You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks.

If some of the above does not line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

Location

This team works closely across Europe and East Coast North America time zones. We are open to candidates who can collaborate effectively within those hours.

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

description:

💰 £60k–£80k base · £120k–£160k OTE, uncapped

About Precoro

Precoro is an agentic procurement, AP and spend management platform.

Most mid-market finance teams find out what they spent after they spent it. Someone chases purchase orders over email, someone keys invoices into the ledger, and the Finance Director learns what a site committed several weeks after it committed it. The software built to fix that was designed for the Fortune 500: six-figure licences, rollouts measured in quarters, a consulting partner attached to the contract. Everyone below that line got left with spreadsheets.

We built Precoro for the companies underneath it. A £60m business with four sites gets the control a global one has, live in about three weeks, on the finance system it already runs: Sage, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics or Xero. Spend gets approved against budget before the money moves. Invoices reconcile against orders and receipts on their own. The CFO sees committed spend the day it is committed rather than at month end.

The AI work is the part we are most excited about, and it is where this category is heading. Agents raise and chase POs, route approvals to the right budget holder, read invoices and match them to orders and goods received. Procurement is close to an ideal case for it: the work is high volume, rule bound, and nobody enjoys doing it. Every hour absorbed is an hour a six-person finance team does not need to hire a seventh person to cover.

We started in 2015. More than 1,000 companies across 80 countries now run on the platform. Precoro already has customers in the UK: Paul Smith, Carwow, In The Style, Tymit - all of whom found us on their own, with no UK sales team behind them at all. 

Now we're building one, and looking for the person to help lead that charge.


What you'll own

  • A curated list of top-tier UK accounts, chosen for fit and live buying signals - yours to work

  • Full-cycle deals with Finance and Procurement leaders, from first outreach through demo to close

  • 1:1 ABM, executive dinners, and a seat at industry events like The FD Show and UK Construction Week - real budget behind you to build relationships

  • The shape of the UK playbook itself: what messaging works, which triggers convert, how the motion should run - decisions the next AEs we hire will inherit from you

  • Room to grow well past this seat - as the UK team builds out, there's a real path into leading it


What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS, with real time spent building your own pipeline

  • A track record with Finance or Ops leaders at mid-market companies, and numbers you can walk through with confidence, quarter by quarter

  • A steady, repeatable approach to prospecting - how you build your lists, which signals or triggers you chase, and what you do to keep pipeline moving in a slow week

  • You've been the first rep in a market before, started out as an SDR or BDR, or already know procurement, P2P, or finance software


Why take this seat

Because you'd own it. No inherited territory, no legacy playbook to follow - you decide how UK outbound gets built, and if something isn't working, you're the one with the standing to change it. That's rare: most AE seats ask you to execute a process someone else designed. This one asks you to design it.

It comes with real autonomy - no micromanagement, judged on results rather than activity - and real backing: a decade-old profitable product, an uncapped comp plan with accelerators, and a market that's already scored and ready to work rather than a blank spreadsheet. And because this is a founding seat, growing the UK team means a genuine shot at leading it, not just being early to it.

Building something from the ground up beats maintaining what's already there.

description:
ABOUT US

At Heim, we are reinventing how healthcare is delivered.

We believe that healthcare is best delivered in the home of patients, and that we are at the cusp of a systemic shift away from hospital based care. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by empowering community nurses with technology that makes care delivery more efficient.

We have created an AI native ecosystem that optimises the complex scheduling involved in delivering community based care, and are on track to automate every non clinical touchpoint for nurses.

To date, our technology has powered our network of 400+ practitioners to deliver c. 30K appointments, and we have shown that our algorithms bring down the cost of at-home visits by c.35% whilst freeing up valuable time for care in doing so. We are growing fast and our ambitions are big – with new international markets on the roadmap, and strong investor backing.

Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM

We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:

  • Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact

  • High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement

  • Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output

  • Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in

  • Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.

You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design and build product features end-to-end across the Heim tech stack – owning them from first principles to production

  • Architect and implement AI-powered workflows: scheduling optimisation, practitioner dispatch, clinical data enrichment, and agentic referral automations that reduce manual touchpoints for nurses
